frequency_question: What proportion of major federal voting reform bills pass the Senate within a comparable window during divided government?
membership_rule: Includes major bills concerning federal election rules, voter registration, or voting access introduced during periods of divided congressional control since 1995. Excludes routine reauthorizations or non-controversial administrative updates.
window: 343 days from introduction or major push

cases.name: Help America Vote Act amendments/related standalone bills
DISCLOSE Act / Democracy Is Strengthened by Casting Light On Spending in Elections
Freedom to Vote Act / For the People Act

provenance_note: rate of 0% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 named major partisan voting bills; believed to represent the comprehensive set of standalone major voting reform legislative pushes under divided government in the modern era.
known_gaps: Minor technical corrections bills pass occasionally, but major structural voting bills under divided government have a historical pass rate of zero.
validity_reason: Institutional polarization and filibuster norms remain stable across multiple congressional sessions.
